articulation.type: hierarchical transform rig with shoulder, elbow, wrist and neck pivots
articulation.allAnimatedPropertiesResetAtFrameZero: Normal cues reset all; speech body/mouth use disjoint ownership and reset together when entering speech

build.note: CLI 1.9.2 keeps local preview builds in memory; --export uses only --publish=local after account authentication. No --publish=web or push is performed.

artworkOrigin: Original in-project vector artwork, authored in build.py and compiled from RML; no downloaded character art.

speech.mouth: Native Speech mouth beneath Head; cavity, teeth and tongue; no DOM/CSS overlay
speech.bodyClock: Normalized actual media.currentTime/media.duration; paused pose timelines, no autonomous speech loop
speech.mouthClock: Decoded local audio RMS level 0–1 scrubs speech-mouth
speech.ownership: speech-mouth owns only mouth properties; speech body timelines exclude every mouth property
speech.activation: playing && role=character && voice person equals this actor && visible && !pause && !reducedMotion

gestures.You: speech-listener-left/right when listener direction supplied; otherwise speech-team open palms

speech.stop: Stop/ended/pause/error/hidden/reduced motion immediately closes the mouth and restores idle; no extra animation frame loop
speech.limitation: Amplitude-driven mouth opening; not phoneme/viseme recognition
